description: This Java class defines a service for an Android widget, specifically for a single note widget in the Nextcloud Notes app. It extends RemoteViewsService and provides a factory for creating RemoteViews for the widget.

classes.name: SingleNoteWidgetService
classes.description: A service that provides RemoteViews for a single note widget in the Android app.

methods.name: onGetViewFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a RemoteViewsFactory for the widget, using the application context and intent.
